name: Yingkou
registryBasis: The supplied WUP code 10170 and point [40.6674879479192, 122.246025468315] identify Yingkou in Liaoning. The official city bureau’s registry-center notice describes real-estate-record query results available through the service counter, self-service terminals, Liaoshitong, and Yingkou Government Service Network; an official bureau interview says access to real-estate registration materials is limited by law to right holders, interested parties, and authorized state bodies. The Yingkou Natural Resources Bureau sponsors a public TianDiTu city map with vector basemap services, but no cadastral parcel layer or safe feature schema was exposed. This entry is distinct from the later WUP row #677, code 9940, also named Yingkou, with point [27.5516903804313, 109.958032960774] in Hunan; the latter is not used here.

remainingUncertainty: Whether the Yingkou Natural Resources Bureau has a public cadastral layer beyond the TianDiTu basemaps; whether the WUP point corresponds to a specific district/revenue unit. The city-name collision with the Hunan WUP row is intentionally left separate.

officialSources.observation: Official Yingkou Municipal Bureau of Natural Resources portal; the publisher is city-local and its notices identify the Yingkou Real Estate Registration Center.

The city bureau notice from the Yingkou Real Estate Registration Center says query-result formats are used for manual service-counter queries, self-service terminals, Liaoshitong, and the Yingkou Government Service Network. It describes record-query channels, not open parcel vectors.

The official bureau’s public interview states that right holders and interested parties may query/copy real-estate registration materials under the applicable rules; it does not establish anonymous access.

The public Yingkou geographic-information service platform lists vector map, imagery, terrain, and other base map services; it is sponsored by Yingkou’s Natural Resources Bureau. No cadastral parcel layer/schema was exposed by the reviewed public page.

Yingkou Government’s natural-resources plan documents the city’s unified real-estate registration and natural-resource information/database and mapping work; it does not publish a safe anonymous parcel layer.
